crew.type.sar-mountain.title: Mountain search observation
crew.type.sar-mountain.brief: A hiker group is overdue on a mountain trail. Fly a visual search pattern above the slopes, photograph clues and hover where the ground team needs a closer look.
crew.type.sar-mountain.obj1: Fly the search rings in order without losing visual line of sight.
crew.type.sar-mountain.obj2: Photograph each marked clue from a safe height.
crew.type.sar-mountain.obj3: Hover over the possible location and report it to the ground team.
crew.type.sar-mountain.chk1: Wind, cloud base and battery checked for mountain flying.
crew.type.sar-mountain.chk2: Search area, altitude limit and no-fly zones agreed.
crew.type.sar-mountain.chk3: Radio call signs and lost-link plan confirmed.
crew.type.sar-mountain.tip: Mountain wind changes near ridges: keep extra height above the slope and turn back with 30% battery.
crew.type.flood-extent.title: Flood extent recording
crew.type.flood-extent.brief: After heavy rain the river has spread over low fields. Photograph the water edge at each marker so planners can draw today's flood boundary.
crew.type.flood-extent.obj1: Photograph the water edge at every marker.
crew.type.flood-extent.obj2: Keep a constant height so photos are comparable.
crew.type.flood-extent.obj3: Report where the water reaches roads or houses.
crew.type.flood-extent.chk1: Rain and visibility checked; no flying in thunderstorms.
crew.type.flood-extent.chk2: Photo height and overlap agreed with the planner.
crew.type.flood-extent.chk3: Landing spot on high ground selected.
crew.type.flood-extent.tip: Fly along the flood edge, not over people; water reflections can hide depth.
crew.type.roof-inspect.title: Roof visual inspection
crew.type.roof-inspect.brief: Typhoon season is coming. Hover above each roof section and photograph loose tiles, gutters and solar fittings for the maintenance crew.
crew.type.roof-inspect.obj1: Hold steady above each roof section for the set time.
crew.type.roof-inspect.obj2: Photograph any damage you can see.
crew.type.roof-inspect.obj3: Mark which sections need a ladder inspection.
crew.type.roof-inspect.chk1: Owner permission and privacy notice confirmed.
crew.type.roof-inspect.chk2: Obstacles such as wires and antennas noted.
crew.type.roof-inspect.chk3: Minimum distance from the roof agreed.
crew.type.roof-inspect.tip: Hover with the camera tilted down; never fly under eaves or between wires.
crew.type.medical-delivery.title: Medical supply delivery
crew.type.medical-delivery.brief: A remote village clinic needs a small parcel of supplies. Follow the agreed corridor and drop the marker parcel at the landing pad.
crew.type.medical-delivery.obj1: Fly the corridor rings in order.
crew.type.medical-delivery.obj2: Release the parcel marker (G) inside the pad.
crew.type.medical-delivery.chk1: Parcel weight within the drone limit.
crew.type.medical-delivery.tip: A heavier drone reacts slower: start braking earlier before the pad.
crew.type.forest-observe.title: Forest environment observation
crew.type.forest-observe.brief: Rangers want a seasonal record of the canopy. Photograph the marked stands and hover over the clearing to count fallen trees.
crew.type.forest-observe.obj2: Hover over the clearing and count fallen trunks.
crew.type.forest-observe.obj3: Note signs of disease, landslides or illegal clearing.
crew.type.forest-observe.chk1: Wildlife breeding season and quiet zones checked.
crew.type.forest-observe.chk2: Canopy height and safe altitude known.
crew.type.forest-observe.chk3: Lost-link return height set above the trees.
crew.type.forest-observe.tip: Keep high above the canopy; GPS and radio signals are weaker under tall trees.
crew.type.solar-inspect.title: Solar panel inspection
crew.type.solar-inspect.brief: Hover along the panel rows and record dirty, cracked or shaded modules so the cleaning team knows where to start.
crew.type.solar-inspect.obj1: Hold above each row long enough for a clear image.
crew.type.solar-inspect.obj3: List rows that need cleaning first.
crew.type.solar-inspect.chk1: Low sun angle and glare considered.
crew.type.solar-inspect.chk2: Distance from inverters and cables kept.
crew.type.solar-inspect.chk3: Site staff informed of the flight.
crew.type.solar-inspect.tip: Glare from panels can blind the camera: fly with the sun behind you.
crew.type.bridge-record.title: Bridge image recording
crew.type.bridge-record.brief: Record the piers and deck joints of the bridge after an earthquake so engineers can compare them with last year's images.
crew.type.bridge-record.obj1: Photograph every pier from the side.
crew.type.bridge-record.obj2: Hover at the deck joint and record it.
crew.type.bridge-record.chk1: Traffic below will not be overflown.
crew.type.bridge-record.chk2: Wind funnelling under the bridge checked.
crew.type.bridge-record.tip: Never fly under the deck: GPS drops and gusts are strong there.
crew.type.storm-assess.title: Post-storm assessment
crew.type.storm-assess.brief: The typhoon has passed. Photograph fallen trees, blocked drains and damaged roofs along the route for the township office.
crew.type.storm-assess.obj2: Keep a written list of what each photo shows.
crew.type.storm-assess.obj3: Finish the loop and return before the wind rises again.
crew.type.storm-assess.chk1: Remaining gusts below the drone limit.
crew.type.storm-assess.chk2: Power lines and broken signs located.
crew.type.storm-assess.chk3: Reporting format agreed with the office.
crew.type.storm-assess.tip: After storms, gusts linger: test-hover at 5 m before flying the route.
crew.type.landslide-watch.title: Slope landslide monitoring
crew.type.landslide-watch.brief: Cracks appeared above the mountain road. Hover at fixed points and photograph the slope so geologists can measure movement over time.
crew.type.landslide-watch.obj1: Hover exactly at each fixed point.
crew.type.landslide-watch.obj2: Photograph the same view as last time.
crew.type.landslide-watch.obj3: Report new cracks or falling rocks.
crew.type.landslide-watch.chk1: Road closure or traffic control arranged.
crew.type.landslide-watch.chk2: Escape direction away from the slope chosen.
crew.type.landslide-watch.tip: Repeatable photos need the same position, height and heading every visit.
crew.type.wildfire-watch.title: Wildfire hotspot watch
crew.type.wildfire-watch.brief: Smoke was reported after a dry spell. Hover upwind of the area at each watch point and record smoke direction for the fire crew.
crew.type.wildfire-watch.obj1: Hold at each watch point upwind of the smoke.
crew.type.wildfire-watch.chk1: Firefighting aircraft schedule checked (stay grounded if they fly).
crew.type.wildfire-watch.chk3: Smoke and heat limits of the drone known.
crew.type.wildfire-watch.tip: If firefighting aircraft appear, land immediately and report.
crew.type.coast-erosion.title: Coastline erosion survey
crew.type.coast-erosion.brief: Waves have cut into the dunes. Photograph the shoreline at the markers so the coastal office can compare it with older maps.
crew.type.coast-erosion.obj1: Photograph each shoreline marker from the sea side.
crew.type.coast-erosion.obj2: Keep the waterline in the middle of the frame.
crew.type.coast-erosion.obj3: Report exposed roots, walls or roads.
crew.type.coast-erosion.chk1: Tide time and sea wind checked.
crew.type.coast-erosion.chk2: Beach users kept clear of the flight path.
crew.type.coast-erosion.chk3: Salt-spray care for the drone planned.
crew.type.coast-erosion.tip: Sea breeze grows in the afternoon; plan to finish before it does.
crew.type.heritage-record.title: Historic building record
crew.type.heritage-record.brief: Make a respectful visual record of the historic building for conservation: photograph each facade and hold above the courtyard.
crew.type.heritage-record.obj1: Photograph each facade from the marked points.
crew.type.heritage-record.obj2: Hold above the courtyard for an overview.
crew.type.heritage-record.obj3: Note damaged ornaments or roof ridges.
crew.type.heritage-record.tip: Heritage sites often have no-fly rules or ceremonies: always ask first.
crew.type.wildlife-census.title: Wetland bird count
crew.type.wildlife-census.brief: Count waterbirds without disturbing them: hold high and still above each zone and record the numbers you see.
crew.type.wildlife-census.obj1: Hold above each zone at the agreed height.
crew.type.wildlife-census.obj3: Report any disturbance and leave if birds flush.
crew.type.wildlife-census.tip: If birds take off, climb away slowly; noise and shadows scare them.
crew.type.crop-survey.title: Farm crop survey
crew.type.crop-survey.brief: Fly a lawn-mower pattern over the fields so the farmer can spot dry patches, pests and storm damage.
crew.type.crop-survey.obj1: Fly every survey ring in order.
crew.type.crop-survey.obj3: Report which field needs water first.
crew.type.crop-survey.chk1: Farmer permission and field boundaries confirmed.
crew.type.crop-survey.chk3: Survey height chosen for image overlap.
crew.type.crop-survey.tip: Straight, evenly spaced lines give the best survey; keep speed constant.
crew.type.lighthouse-inspect.title: Lighthouse exterior check
crew.type.lighthouse-inspect.brief: Check the lantern room, railings and walls of the lighthouse after winter storms and photograph rust or cracks.
crew.type.lighthouse-inspect.obj1: Photograph the lantern room from each marker.
crew.type.lighthouse-inspect.obj3: Report rust, cracks and loose parts.
crew.type.lighthouse-inspect.chk2: Strong sea wind and gusts checked.
crew.type.lighthouse-inspect.chk3: Lens light not shone at or blocked.
crew.type.lighthouse-inspect.tip: Headlands accelerate the wind: fly on the sheltered side first.
crew.type.relay-comms.title: Mountain radio relay practice
crew.type.relay-comms.brief: Valleys block radio. Practise holding a relay position on the ridge line so two teams can hear each other.
crew.type.relay-comms.obj1: Reach the ridge position through the ring.
crew.type.relay-comms.obj2: Hold at each relay point for the set time.
crew.type.relay-comms.obj3: Report battery and time on station.
crew.type.relay-comms.chk1: Relay frequencies and call signs agreed.
crew.type.relay-comms.chk2: Time on station planned with battery reserve.
crew.type.relay-comms.tip: A relay is only useful while it stays put; small, early corrections.
crew.type.aerial-survey.title: Light-aircraft area survey
crew.type.aerial-survey.brief: A light aircraft surveys a wide area after a disaster. Fly the survey gates at a steady height and speed and keep the horizon level.
crew.type.aerial-survey.obj2: Keep height and speed steady between gates.
crew.type.aerial-survey.obj3: Report the area covered and any hazards.
crew.type.aerial-survey.chk1: Weather minimums for visual flight met.
crew.type.aerial-survey.chk3: Fuel reserve and alternate field planned.
crew.type.aerial-survey.tip: Bank gently and use the rudder in turns; avoid steep turns near terrain.
crew.type.relief-sorting.title: Relief supply sorting
crew.type.relief-sorting.brief: Drive the ground robot between the sorting stations of a relief warehouse and stop at each so volunteers can load the right boxes.
crew.type.relief-sorting.obj1: Stop inside each station for the set time.
crew.type.relief-sorting.obj2: Mark the last station with a marker (G).
crew.type.relief-sorting.tip: Indoors and among people, slow is safe: never exceed walking speed.
crew.type.accessible-route.title: Accessible evacuation route check
crew.type.accessible-route.brief: Check that a wheelchair-accessible evacuation route is clear: drive through every gate and photograph obstacles such as steps or parked scooters.
crew.type.accessible-route.obj3: Report where a wheelchair could not pass.
crew.type.accessible-route.tip: Drive the route as a wheelchair user would: kerbs and slopes matter.
crew.type.road-obstacle.title: Road obstacle report
crew.type.road-obstacle.brief: After heavy rain, drive the patrol route, photograph fallen rocks or trees and mark the worst spot for the road crew.
crew.type.road-obstacle.obj2: Place a warning marker (G) at the worst spot.
crew.type.road-obstacle.obj3: Finish the route and report the road status.
crew.type.road-obstacle.chk1: Hazard lights and reflective vest ready.
crew.type.road-obstacle.tip: Stop well before obstacles; rocks can keep falling after rain.
crew.type.shelter-inspect.title: Evacuation shelter inspection
crew.type.shelter-inspect.brief: Before the typhoon, inspect the school shelter: stop at the entrance, toilets and storage and photograph anything blocked or broken.
crew.type.shelter-inspect.obj2: Photograph blocked exits or broken fittings.
crew.type.shelter-inspect.obj3: Report the shelter as ready or not ready.
crew.type.shelter-inspect.chk1: Shelter keys and manager contact ready.
crew.type.shelter-inspect.chk2: Checklist for water, power and lighting prepared.
crew.type.shelter-inspect.tip: A shelter is only ready if everyone can get in, including wheelchair users.
crew.type.load-balance.title: Cargo load balance practice
crew.type.load-balance.brief: Practise driving a loaded robot: stop at the loading points, then drive the slope gate smoothly without tipping.
crew.type.load-balance.obj1: Stop gently at each loading point.
crew.type.load-balance.obj2: Drive through the slope gate without sudden turns.
crew.type.load-balance.obj3: Report the load and any instability.
crew.type.load-balance.chk1: Load limit and centre of gravity checked.
crew.type.load-balance.tip: A loaded robot tips more easily: slow down before turning, never turn on a slope.
crew.type.vehicle-precheck.title: Vehicle dispatch check
crew.type.vehicle-precheck.brief: Before dispatch, drive the short test course: check brakes, steering and lights through the gates and stop at the inspection box.
crew.type.vehicle-precheck.obj2: Stop fully inside the inspection box.
crew.type.vehicle-precheck.obj3: Report any warning on the dashboard.
crew.type.vehicle-precheck.tip: Test the brakes gently at low speed before the first gate.
crew.type.relay-transport.title: Team relay transport
crew.type.relay-transport.brief: Follow the lead robot in a convoy, keep a safe gap, then hand over at the gate.
crew.type.relay-transport.obj1: Stay within the set distance of the lead robot.
crew.type.relay-transport.tip: Keep a constant gap: watch the leader's speed, not just its position.
crew.type.trail-patrol.title: Trail safety patrol
crew.type.trail-patrol.brief: Patrol the trail with the ground robot after rain and photograph washouts, fallen branches and broken handrails.
crew.type.trail-patrol.obj3: Report whether the trail can reopen.
crew.type.trail-patrol.chk2: Slope limit of the robot known.
crew.type.trail-patrol.tip: Wet slopes are slippery even for robots: slow down on descents.
crew.type.tunnel-portal.title: Tunnel portal check
crew.type.tunnel-portal.brief: Drive to the tunnel portals and photograph rockfall nets, drainage and lighting before the road reopens.
crew.type.tunnel-portal.obj2: Drive through the safety gate slowly.
crew.type.tunnel-portal.obj3: Report rockfall, water or lighting faults.
crew.type.tunnel-portal.tip: Your eyes need time to adjust at tunnel entrances: slow down before the portal.
crew.type.market-logistics.title: Community supply drop
crew.type.market-logistics.brief: Bring water to the community centre through narrow old streets: stop at each pick-up, pass the narrow gate and mark the drop-off.
crew.type.market-logistics.obj2: Pass the narrow street gate without touching walls.
crew.type.market-logistics.obj3: Mark the drop-off with a marker (G).
crew.type.market-logistics.tip: In narrow streets, steer early and gently; watch both sides.
crew.type.marine-litter.title: Marine litter recording
crew.type.marine-litter.brief: Mark floating litter for the clean-up crew: drop a buoy at each patch and photograph the largest one.
crew.type.marine-litter.obj1: Drop a marker buoy (G) at every litter patch.
crew.type.marine-litter.obj3: Report the total patches and drift direction.
crew.type.marine-litter.chk1: Life jackets on and engine checked.
crew.type.marine-litter.tip: Approach litter slowly from downwind so it does not drift into the propeller.
crew.type.harbor-inspect.title: Harbour facility inspection
crew.type.harbor-inspect.brief: Inspect the breakwater, fenders and navigation lights of the harbour by boat and photograph damage.
crew.type.harbor-inspect.obj1: Photograph each facility marker from the water.
crew.type.harbor-inspect.obj2: Pass the harbour entrance gate at slow speed.
crew.type.harbor-inspect.chk3: Speed limit inside the harbour known.
crew.type.harbor-inspect.tip: Inside harbours, keep to the right and at dead-slow speed.
crew.type.lifebuoy-delivery.title: Lifebuoy delivery practice
crew.type.lifebuoy-delivery.brief: Practise a rescue approach: pass the approach gate, drop the lifebuoy marker within reach of the person in the water and leave safely.
crew.type.lifebuoy-delivery.obj2: Drop the lifebuoy marker (G) at the target.
crew.type.lifebuoy-delivery.obj3: Leave without crossing the target's position.
crew.type.lifebuoy-delivery.chk1: Rescue throw line and lifebuoy ready.
crew.type.lifebuoy-delivery.tip: Never run the propeller near a person in the water: neutral, drift, drop.
crew.type.water-sampling.title: Water quality sampling
crew.type.water-sampling.brief: Hold the boat still at each sampling point long enough to take a water sample, and photograph any algae bloom.
crew.type.water-sampling.obj1: Hold position at each sampling point.
crew.type.water-sampling.tip: Hold position by pointing into the wind or current and using short throttle bursts.
crew.type.pier-inspect.title: Pier exterior inspection
crew.type.pier-inspect.brief: Check the pier piles and ladders from the water and photograph corrosion or broken boards.
crew.type.pier-inspect.obj2: Hold beside the ladder for a close look.
crew.type.pier-inspect.chk1: Pier closed to visitors during the check.
crew.type.pier-inspect.tip: Approach piers slowly at an angle and keep the bow into the waves.
crew.type.lake-patrol.title: Lake safety patrol
crew.type.lake-patrol.brief: Patrol the lake shore during a festival: pass every patrol gate and keep clear of swimmers and paddle boards.
crew.type.lake-patrol.obj2: Keep below the speed limit near shore.
crew.type.lake-patrol.chk1: Lake rules and speed zones known.
crew.type.lake-patrol.chk3: Radio check with the shore team.
crew.type.lake-patrol.tip: Your wake can tip paddle boards: slow down near small craft.
crew.type.oil-sheen-watch.title: Harbour sheen observation
crew.type.oil-sheen-watch.brief: A thin oil sheen was reported in the harbour. Photograph its edges, mark the source area and keep the boat out of it.
crew.type.oil-sheen-watch.obj1: Photograph each sheen marker from upwind.
crew.type.oil-sheen-watch.obj2: Mark the suspected source with a marker (G).
crew.type.oil-sheen-watch.obj3: Report size and drift; do not enter the sheen.
crew.type.oil-sheen-watch.chk3: No smoking or open flames on board.
crew.type.oil-sheen-watch.tip: Stay upwind and outside the sheen; observation only, no clean-up.
crew.type.reef-survey.title: Coral reef observation
crew.type.reef-survey.brief: Survey the reef with the underwater drone: photograph the coral at each marker and hold still over the bleaching patch.
crew.type.reef-survey.obj2: Hold above the bleaching patch without touching it.
crew.type.reef-survey.chk1: Thruster guards fitted; no contact with coral.
crew.type.reef-survey.tip: Never touch the reef; keep one metre above it and move slowly.
crew.type.seagrass-record.title: Seagrass bed recording
crew.type.seagrass-record.brief: Record how far the seagrass bed reaches: photograph its edges and hold above the centre for a density check.
crew.type.seagrass-record.obj3: Report bare patches and anchoring damage.
crew.type.seagrass-record.tip: Thrusters stir up silt: stay high enough to keep the water clear.
crew.type.hull-inspect.title: Ship hull visual check
crew.type.hull-inspect.brief: Check the hull of a moored ferry below the waterline: hold at the propeller and rudder and photograph fouling or damage.
crew.type.hull-inspect.obj3: Report damage, fouling or entangled ropes.
crew.type.hull-inspect.chk1: Engines of the ferry locked off.
crew.type.hull-inspect.chk2: Tether kept clear of the propeller.
crew.type.hull-inspect.tip: Only inspect a hull when its engines are locked off; mind your tether.
crew.type.cable-check.title: Subsea cable visual check
crew.type.cable-check.brief: Follow the cable route with the underwater drone through the inspection gates and photograph any exposed section.
crew.type.cable-check.obj1: Pass every inspection gate along the route.
crew.type.cable-check.obj3: Report anchors or fishing gear near the cable.
crew.type.cable-check.tip: Follow the route, never pull or touch the cable.
crew.type.lake-bottom.title: Lake bottom survey
crew.type.lake-bottom.brief: Dive in the lake to check the intake area and photograph debris on the bottom before the rainy season.
crew.type.lake-bottom.tip: Lakes get dark quickly with depth: switch on the lights and descend slowly.
crew.type.phishing.title: Phishing email spotting
crew.type.phishing.brief: Read three practice messages and decide which ones are phishing before anyone clicks a link.
crew.type.phishing.obj1: Check sender, links and urgency in each message.
crew.type.phishing.obj2: Explain the clue that gave each phish away.
crew.type.phishing.obj3: Report the phishing message to the team lead.
crew.type.phishing.chk1: Never use real accounts or passwords.
crew.type.phishing.chk2: Hover links, do not click them.
crew.type.phishing.tip: Urgency and unusual requests are the strongest warning signs.
crew.type.mfa.title: Multi-factor sign-in practice
crew.type.mfa.brief: Walk through a safe multi-factor sign-in and decide what to do with an unexpected approval prompt.
crew.type.mfa.obj1: List the factors used in the sign-in.
crew.type.mfa.obj2: Decide what to do with an unexpected prompt.
crew.type.mfa.obj3: Explain how to store recovery codes.
crew.type.mfa.tip: Never approve a sign-in you did not start.
crew.type.backup.title: Backup and restore drill
crew.type.backup.brief: Practise restoring a team folder from yesterday's backup and check that nothing is missing.
crew.type.backup.obj2: Restore it to a test folder.
crew.type.backup.chk1: Test folder separate from live data.
crew.type.backup.tip: A backup only counts if you have tested the restore.
crew.type.fact-check.title: Public message verification
crew.type.fact-check.brief: A dramatic disaster photo is spreading online. Check its source, date and place before sharing it with the team.
crew.type.fact-check.obj3: Decide share / do not share and explain why.
crew.type.fact-check.tip: Old photos often reappear after new disasters: check the date.
crew.type.permissions.title: Account permission review
crew.type.permissions.brief: Review who can edit the team's shared drive and remove access that is no longer needed.
crew.type.permissions.obj2: Mark access that is no longer needed.
crew.type.permissions.obj3: Explain least privilege to a teammate.
crew.type.permissions.tip: Give people the access they need today, not forever.
crew.type.handover.title: Incident log handover
crew.type.handover.brief: Hand over an incident log to the next shift so they can continue without asking you.
crew.type.handover.obj1: Summarise what happened and what is open.
crew.type.handover.chk2: Times written in one time zone.
crew.type.handover.tip: A good handover answers: what, so what, now what.
crew.type.comms-outage.title: Communication outage teamwork
crew.type.comms-outage.brief: The mobile network is down. Agree on backup channels, check-in times and runner messages for the team.
crew.type.comms-outage.obj1: Pick a primary and a backup channel.
crew.type.comms-outage.tip: Short, scheduled check-ins beat long, random messages.
crew.type.weather-brief.title: Weather briefing for flying
crew.type.weather-brief.brief: Read today's wind, cloud, rain and visibility and decide go / no-go for each vehicle.
crew.type.weather-brief.obj1: Read wind, gusts and cloud base.
crew.type.weather-brief.obj2: Compare them with each vehicle's limits.
crew.type.weather-brief.tip: Gusts matter more than average wind for small drones.
crew.type.map-reading.title: Map and coordinate reading
crew.type.map-reading.brief: Find the meeting point from coordinates, then describe the route using landmarks the team can see.
crew.type.map-reading.obj1: Plot the coordinates on the map.
crew.type.map-reading.obj3: Read the coordinates back to a teammate.
crew.type.map-reading.tip: Always read coordinates back: one wrong digit can be kilometres.
crew.type.image-privacy.title: Drone image privacy check
crew.type.image-privacy.brief: Before sharing mission photos, blur faces, licence plates and private yards and keep only what the mission needs.
crew.type.image-privacy.obj1: Find personal details in the photos.
crew.type.image-privacy.obj3: Keep only images the mission needs.
crew.type.image-privacy.tip: Collect less: what you never store cannot leak.
crew.noVoice: No voice for this language on this device; please read the text.
crew.step.brief: Read the briefing, confirm your role and tick the checklist.
crew.step.controls: Left hand W A S D: climb / descend and turn. Right hand arrows: forward / back and slide. On phones use the two sticks below the view.
crew.step.controlsGround: W / S or ↑ / ↓ drive and reverse; A / D or ← / → steer. On phones use the sticks below the view.
crew.step.start: Press Start (Space). The drone lifts to about 3 m and waits for you.
crew.step.startOther: Press Start (Space) and move off slowly.
crew.step.navigate: Station {n} of {total}: {d} to the {dir}. The navigator calls distance and direction.
crew.step.act.photo: Face the landmark and press F to photograph it.
crew.step.act.hold: Stop inside the marker and hold steady for {s} s.
crew.step.act.beacon: Stop over the marker and press G to drop it.
crew.step.act.formation: Follow the guide vehicle within {m} m for {s} s.
crew.step.return: All stations done. Return to the start point and land or stop there.
crew.step.report: Write your report, check the score and export the record.
crew.reportPh: What did you see? What should the next team know?
crew.ai: Crew Lab AI coach (this site’s model)
crew.fictional: Educational, non-combat exercise at a real place used only as geographic context.
crew.digitalNote: Desk exercise: no vehicle. Work through the steps with your team.
crew.roleTip.pilot: Operator: fly smoothly, keep the vehicle in sight and say each manoeuvre before you make it.
crew.roleTip.navigator: Navigator: read the distance and direction to the next station aloud and watch the minimap.
crew.roleTip.observer: Observer: watch for wires, people, birds and weather, and call "stop" whenever it is unsafe.
crew.roleTip.coordinator: Coordinator: keep time, track the checklist and log each event for the report.
crew.simIntro: Real terrain, satellite imagery, buildings, weather, sun and moon at this place. The view fills the screen and the hand pads and controls sit right below it.
crew.imagery: Satellite image © Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics
crew.coachLoading: Loading the Crew Lab coach model {p}%
crew.coachFail: The Crew Lab coach is not available, so the built-in guide answers instead.
crew.homeIntro: Practise observation, communication and teamwork through {n} non-combat missions at real places: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater and at the desk.
crew.debriefIntro: Talk through what went well, what was hard and what the next team should do differently.
crew.coachLocalNote: Questions go to the Crew Lab coach model running in your browser; nothing is sent to a server.
